## What changed

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Deterministic tests pass.
- [ ] New pipeline behavior has a regression test.
- [ ] Report-behavior changes cite a public or synthetic example and checked source anchors.
- [ ] Documentation and version metadata are aligned.

## Trust boundary

Explain any change to network access, local-PDF handling, archive/media processing, report grounding, or external evidence. Write `No change` when none applies.

## Safety

- [ ] No PDF, source archive, generated report workspace, cache, secret, or personal data is committed.
- [ ] I did not weaken size limits, path checks, or validation without documenting the reason and tests.
